title: Round 43 - round 40 fixes, trees like the question, whole dot-paper pictures
intro: The 4 items marked wrong in round 40 are fixed. Every mark-scheme tree now has the same shape as the question tree. Dot paper is always one whole picture. The same fixes also changed a few other questions; they are here for you to check too.

reasons: Tree - the branch lengths and angles are measured from the question's tree now.
Question 5 - the dot paper with the circles is one whole picture now (before it was cut off above and below).
